text_block_list.text: The day of the NHK Mile Cup. Just like on the day of the Oka Sho, Seeking the Pearl seemed to be sensing something again.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: It's the opposite of how it was during the Oka Sho. I feel a closeness... a deep sympathy toward her...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
It seems this NHK Mile Cup
is a race full of promise for me.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yes, a race where you feel a bond of souls.
It just resonates so remarkably well with my vibe.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Gooood! Very good! I feel like
I can pull off an excellent run!

It seems something about Seeking the Pearl's "mysterious intuition"
struck a chord with her.
In any case, approaching it with a positive mindset is a very good thing.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, this "NHK Mile Cup"
is the prelude to taking on the world.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"I'll deliver the most fabulous run,
and eventually export it straight to the world!"
choice_data_list: Yeah, 1600m counter-clockwise is your best condition anyway.
Yeah, 1600m counter-clockwise is the best, after all.

text_block_list.text:
"I offered my personal observation as a Trainer:
that naturally, she seemed to run
just a bit smoother counterclockwise."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, I wasn't really conscious of it,
but there might be a subtle vibe to it."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
That's great, just great!
The distance is perfect, the turns are spot-on, and our destined chemistry is so vivid!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: That's right. Today is... a day just for me...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"I'll prove it to you!
Right in front of all these galleries of fans!"
